STAFF_PREFERENCE.description: Prefer slots explicitly marked as PREFERRED by the assigned instructor

CAPACITY_FIT.description: Prefer rooms that fit the student count with less unused capacity

EQUIPMENT_MATCH.description: Prefer rooms whose available equipment closely matches the session requirements

COMPACTNESS.description: Reward adjacent sessions for the same section or instructor to reduce unnecessary timetable gaps

ROOM_UTILIZATION.description: Reduce unnecessary room spreading by preferring solutions that use fewer active rooms when feasible
